q: Which applications depend on ledger-db, directly or indirectly?
gold: SELECT ?app WHERE { ?a ops:dependsOn+ id:app\/ledger-db ; ops:name ?app }

q: Which incidents are still open?
gold: SELECT ?id WHERE { ?i a inc:Incident ; inc:id ?id ; inc:status "open" }

q: Which application is the top-ranked root-cause candidate for INC-5377?
gold: SELECT ?app WHERE { ?c corr:leadsTo/inc:id "INC-5377" ; corr:rank 1 ; corr:candidateApp/ops:name ?app }

q: Which vendors does payments-api use?
gold: SELECT ?v WHERE { id:app\/payments-api ops:usesVendor/ops:name ?v }

q: Which applications does checkout depend on directly?
gold: SELECT ?app WHERE { id:app\/checkout ops:dependsOn/ops:name ?app }

q: Which business processes would be affected if ledger-db failed? Count a process as affected when ledger-db or any application that depends on ledger-db, directly or indirectly, supports it.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?p WHERE { ?a ops:dependsOn* id:app\/ledger-db ; ops:supports/ops:name ?p }

q: Which applications depend on no other application?
gold: SELECT ?app WHERE { ?a a ops:Application ; ops:name ?app FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?a ops:dependsOn ?b } }

q: What are all the aliases of payments-api?
gold: SELECT ?alias WHERE { id:app\/payments-api ops:alias ?alias }

q: Which application is also known as "finder"?
gold: SELECT ?app WHERE { ?a ops:alias "finder" ; ops:name ?app }

q: Which vendors are used by checkout or by any application checkout depends on, directly or indirectly?
gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?v WHERE { id:app\/checkout ops:dependsOn* ?a . ?a ops:usesVendor/ops:name ?v }

q: What was the mitigation for the incident titled "Search timeouts"?
gold: SELECT ?m WHERE { ?i inc:title "Search timeouts" ; inc:mitigation ?m }

q: How many alerts are there of each severity? Give the severity and the count.
gold: SELECT ?sev (COUNT(?e) AS ?n) WHERE { ?e a evt:Alert ; evt:severity ?sev } GROUP BY ?sev

q: Which deployments (application and version) happened in the hour before INC-5377 opened?
gold: SELECT ?app ?v WHERE { ?i inc:id "INC-5377" ; evt:at ?o . ?d a evt:Deployment ; evt:on/ops:name ?app ; evt:version ?v ; evt:at ?at FILTER(?at < ?o && ?at >= ?o - "PT1H"^^xsd:dayTimeDuration) }

q: Which applications had a config change in November 2026?
gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?app WHERE { ?c a evt:ConfigChange ; evt:on/ops:name ?app ; evt:at ?at FILTER(?at >= "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime && ?at < "2026-12-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime) }

q: Which application has the most events, counting deployments, config changes, alerts, log errors, metric anomalies and trace events but not incidents?
gold: SELECT ?app WHERE { VALUES ?t { evt:Deployment evt:ConfigChange evt:Alert evt:LogError evt:MetricAnomaly evt:TraceFailed evt:TraceSlow } ?e a ?t ; evt:on/ops:name ?app } GROUP BY ?app ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?e)) LIMIT 1

q: Which metric anomalies happened on applications that support the "card payments" business process? Give the application and the metric.
gold: SELECT ?app ?m WHERE { ?a ops:supports/ops:name "card payments" ; ops:name ?app . ?e a evt:MetricAnomaly ; evt:on ?a ; evt:metric ?m }

q: Which applications use a vendor that appears in a news item?
gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?app WHERE { ?n a evt:NewsItem ; evt:mentions ?v . ?a ops:usesVendor ?v ; ops:name ?app }

q: Which incidents happened on an application that has at least one alias?
gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?id WHERE { ?i a inc:Incident ; inc:id ?id ; evt:on ?a . ?a ops:alias ?x }

q: Which applications have never had an alert?
gold: SELECT ?app WHERE { ?a a ops:Application ; ops:name ?app FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?e a evt:Alert ; evt:on ?a } }

q: Which resolved incident took the longest from opening to resolution?
gold: SELECT ?id WHERE { ?i inc:id ?id ; evt:at ?o ; inc:resolvedAt ?r } ORDER BY DESC(?r - ?o) LIMIT 1

q: For each incident, which application is its rank-1 root-cause candidate? Give the incident id and the application.
gold: SELECT ?id ?app WHERE { ?c corr:leadsTo/inc:id ?id ; corr:rank 1 ; corr:candidateApp/ops:name ?app }

q: Which alerts fired on applications that INC-5377's application depends on, directly or indirectly, on the day INC-5377 opened (2026-11-22, UTC)? Give the application and the alert name.
gold: SELECT ?app ?s WHERE { ?i inc:id "INC-5377" ; evt:on ?root . ?root ops:dependsOn+ ?a . ?a ops:name ?app . ?e a evt:Alert ; evt:on ?a ; evt:summary ?s ; evt:at ?at FILTER(?at >= "2026-11-22T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime && ?at < "2026-11-23T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime) }
